item.text:
<linkedin_post>OpenAI is expanding the safety limits in ChatGPT for users it predicts are under 18. The new restrictions will cover practical information about weapons and security systems that could be misused to facilitate violence, even when a question appears harmless.

The company says its age-prediction system will continue assessing signals as people use ChatGPT and move users into the teen experience when appropriate. Adults placed there incorrectly can verify their age through Persona to remove the additional restrictions.

OpenAI is also working on a notification for parents with linked accounts if a teen’s account is paused after repeated conversations about violence. Teens will still be able to ask ChatGPT for help preventing or de-escalating violence, seeking support and connecting with a trusted adult.</linkedin_post>
